stories.title: Dad who made bomb to 'protect family' is jailed
stories.summary: Ben Banham, 38, has been sentenced to 28 months in prison for creating a bomb at his Essex home.

stories.title: University may house 150 MoD staff on campus
stories.summary: This is one option it is considering for surplus accommodation as student numbers fall, it says.

stories.title: Olympian helps teens who face falling off 'care cliff'
stories.summary: Fatima Whitbread hosts her second event showcasing the support for care leavers.

stories.title: School raffles Amazon vouchers to stop GTA 6 skiving
stories.summary: The long wait for the latest GTA video game ended at midnight and has become a concern for schools.

stories.title: Volunteers recruited to respond to 999 calls
stories.summary: Responders in similar East of England schemes are first to 88% of emergencies they attend.

stories.title: Reduce water use as drought continues, public told
stories.summary: Essex and Suffolk Water says its reservoirs are at "critically low" levels.

stories.title: Cash-strapped council proposes cuts to children and homelessness services
stories.summary: Savings worth £27.3m need to be made, Thurrock Council says.

stories.title: M11 shuts after lorry crash and fuel spillage
stories.summary: There are delays of 90 minutes in the area, say National Highways.

stories.title: Damage on A12 caused by blockage
stories.summary: National Highways says the road reopened on Wednesday following repairs.

stories.title: Hospital therapy dog Rolo makes his final rounds
stories.summary: Rolo, once rescued from a puppy farm in 2013, has brought joy to patients as a Pets As Therapy dog.

stories.title: Teens killed rival dealer in turf war, court told
stories.summary: The defendants used a 30cm knife to fatally stab the rival drug dealer in Chelmsford, jurors hear.

stories.title: Diving suit fundraiser Lloyd Scott dies
stories.summary: Tributes praise his "determination, generosity and willingness to push himself" for others.
